hotel.name: Fairmont La Hacienda Costa Del Sol

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the Mediterranean coast of southern Spain between Sotogrande and La Línea, in a part of the coast that is less known and less developed than nearby resort areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: This part of Spain’s Mediterranean coast, between Sotogrande and La Línea, is less known and less developed than some of the more popular resort areas nearby.

verified_facts.text: The resort has direct access to La Alcaidesa beach, a sandy beach with the Punta Carbonera lighthouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property also has direct access to La Alcaidesa beach, a sandy strip that runs for four kilometres and is presided over by the Punta Carbonera lighthouse.

verified_facts.text: Guests can book tee times on the Links and Heathland golf courses, designed by Peter Alliss, Clive Clark and Kurtis Bowman.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’ll want to reserve tee times on the Links and Heathland courses designed by Peter Alliss, Clive Clark, and Kurtis Bowman.

verified_facts.text: The golf courses have views of the Rock of Gibraltar, the Costa del Sol and, in the distance, Morocco.
verified_facts.excerpt: The courses even have views of the Rock of Gibraltar, the Costa del Sol and, in the distance, Morocco.

verified_facts.text: The resort's architecture is by dAAr studio, with terraces and steps built on a hillside between the main building and the freestanding villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort’s striking architecture is the work of dAAr studio, with offices in Madrid, Valladolid, and Málaga.

verified_facts.text: The interiors are by Studio Ibu and use natural materials such as Campaspero limestone, noble woods, and jute and linen textiles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Studio Ibu was responsible for the interiors, which echo the surrounding landscape through the use of natural materials such as Campaspero limestone, noble woods, textiles such as jute and linen

verified_facts.text: The lobby has a large window overlooking the Mediterranean and a sculpture of a whale's tail.
verified_facts.excerpt: The grand entry into the hotel includes a colossal window overlooking the Mediterranean

verified_facts.text: A sculpture of a whale's tail stands in the middle of the lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the middle of the space, a sculpture of a whale’s tail sets the mood.

verified_facts.text: All rooms have terraces with views of the sea, the golf courses, or the large swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: all have terraces with views of the sea, the golf courses, or the large swimming pool that serves as a sort of social centre for the resort.

verified_facts.text: Chef Benito Gómez, behind Bardal in Ronda, is in charge of the restaurant Dalmar, which serves food for sharing in a relaxed atmosphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the Fairmont, he is in charge of the Dalmar restaurant, where his goal is to serve delicious food in a relaxed atmosphere, with many options for sharing

verified_facts.text: El Faro de la Hacienda serves breakfast, lunch and dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: There's no shortage of talent at El Faro de la Hacienda, open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

verified_facts.text: The spa area includes hammams, a sauna, hydrotherapy, a snow fountain and a yoga studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are six physiotherapy, massage, and compression treatment rooms, two hammams, a sauna, swimming pools, hydrotherapy, a snow fountain, a yoga studio, and a cardio room.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments use products from Subtle Energies and 111Skincare.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu includes different face and body treatments using products from Australia’s Subtle Energies and the London-based 111Skincare

verified_facts.text: Guests can book yacht trips from the port of Sotogrande and sail among dolphins.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can book yacht trips from the port of Sotogrande and sail among dolphins.

verified_facts.text: Gibraltar International Airport is about a 25-minute drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gibraltar International Airport (GIB): ~25-minute drive.

verified_facts.text: Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport is about a 1 hour 20-minute drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport (AGP): ~1 hour 20-minute drive.

verified_facts.text: Airport and station transfers need to be booked 48 hours prior to arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: Transfers need to be booked 48 hours prior to arrival.

verified_facts.text: Parking at the resort is available for an additional fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

verified_facts.text: The resort has a network of paths for buggies, available to guests 24 hours a day.
verified_facts.excerpt: a network of paths for buggies, which are available to guests 24 hours a day

verified_facts.text: The hotel is LEED certified.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is LEED certified
